tests: B01: standard OSV arrays, empty fallback and unknown CVSS retain every finding
findings.change: OSV severity arrays and database fallback are parsed; CVSS v3 base scores are calculated. Unsupported severities remain UNKNOWN findings and block policy.

tests: B02: rejected/non-OK dependency lookups remain ERROR and retry rather than cache clean
findings.change: Network/HTTP/invalid response and unresolved-version errors remain explicit incomplete coverage, preserve successful findings and are never cached as clean scans.

tests: B03: unavailable infrastructure is an explicit ERROR; array and backend object normalize
findings.change: Infrastructure returns normalized arrays or backend evidence; unavailable scanners and malformed results return ERROR with policyPassed=false and visible unavailable UI. Optional backend delegation is used only if supplied.

tests: B04: every numeric maximum applies before fail-on severity, including low fail-on
findings.change: Every numeric maximum is checked independently, then cumulative fail-on severity rules apply; unknown findings cannot pass.

tests: B05: policy UI preserves zero and rejects negative/fractional maxima
findings.change: Zero is preserved, blank fields use defaults, and fractional/negative values show validation errors without saving.

tests: B06: save and selected-suite scan use awaited configured LVXApp storage
findings.change: Security suite save, selected-suite scan and refresh use the configured awaited LVXApp storage interface.

tests: B07: result rendering orders critical before high and low
findings.change: Nullish fallback preserves critical severity rank zero when rendering mixed findings.

tests: B08: history retains 100 scans with details and newest-first identity
findings.change: History reads the full retention window before appending and stores detail/error evidence; 120 writes retain exactly the newest 100.

tests: B09/B10/B11: shared const fixtures, awaited promises and teardown on failure
findings.change: Setup const/let declarations share lexical bindings with async test and teardown closures; an explicit fixture object is also available.

tests: B09/B10/B11: shared const fixtures, awaited promises and teardown on failure
B10: cooperative async timeout fails and aborts its test signal
findings.change: Custom JavaScript awaits test promises and await-based setup/teardown, reports asynchronous failures and provides a cooperative AbortSignal timeout. Early setup returns cannot silently skip tests.

tests: B09/B10/B11: shared const fixtures, awaited promises and teardown on failure
B11/B12: actual unittest discovery executes failures and always runs teardown
findings.change: Both languages execute cleanup in finally. JavaScript cleanup closures retain initialized setup bindings even if later setup fails; primary and cleanup errors are separate.

tests: B11/B12: actual unittest discovery executes failures and always runs teardown
B12: actual pytest discovery never passes a failing or empty suite
findings.change: Python unittest invokes the real loader/runner; pytest invokes real package discovery/main and reads executed counts. Empty tests and unavailable engines fail visibly. Unsupported Jest/Java/.NET modes are not treated as successful browser scripts.

tests: B13/B19: every advanced step receives runner window and exact threshold stays zero
B13/B14: awaitable pipeline visual execution inspects its own page and removes its iframe
findings.change: Every advanced action receives the actual execution window. An awaited isolated visual executor supports pipeline callers and removes its owned iframe.

tests: B14: unlabelled controls without IDs fail; associated, wrapping and ARIA names pass
B13/B14: awaitable pipeline visual execution inspects its own page and removes its iframe
findings.change: Every input/select/textarea is checked for accessible naming including no-ID, associated/wrapping labels, ARIA and relevant native names; hidden controls are excluded.

tests: B15: each integration receives only its configured success/failure event
findings.change: Delivery filters each integration by its own all/success/failure preferences and normalized result status.

tests: B16: collaboration IDs are unique and version rendering leaves standalone versions intact
findings.change: Shared root/storage dependency verified: collaboration input/list have distinct IDs and version rendering cannot overwrite standalone controls.

tests: B17: Monaco parses complete multiword cells, tab cells and assignment targets
findings.change: Diagnostics split Robot cells on real separators, preserve complete multiword keywords and handle assignment targets, tabs and continuation rows.

tests: B18: Resume runs to completion, Step pauses once, and Stop unblocks breakpoints
B18: debugger retains error status and failure details after cleanup
findings.change: Debugger tracks run/step state, pauses exactly at requested boundaries, handles Stop while paused, exposes live controls and preserves error outcomes after cleanup.

tests: B13/B19: every advanced step receives runner window and exact threshold stays zero
B19: exact image comparison detects one-channel and alpha-only differences
findings.change: Zero screenshot tolerance remains zero with validated 0..100 input; exact mode detects any changed RGB or alpha channel.

tests: B20: selector proposals escape literal punctuation, digits and attribute quotes
findings.change: Identifier components use CSS.escape (with fallback), attribute strings are escaped, and each proposed selector is validated against the picked element.

tests: B21: generators emit real Robot cells and continuation arguments, and prevent unsupported external checks from passing
B21: actual Robot dry-run accepts both builders; execution preserves multiline literal arguments
B21: Monaco completion snippets retain complete keywords and separate every argument cell
findings.change: Both builders and editor snippets emit proper Robot cells, literal escaped arguments and multiline continuation rows. Universal keyword names match Selenium. Advanced checks save as visual steps; external Robot uses an explicit Fail rather than skipping those checks.

review_passes.evidence: All B01-B21 mapped individually; B16 root/storage markup dependency included and independently tested.
Improved CVSS parsing and incomplete coverage, shared lexical setup/cleanup scope, real framework discovery, real Robot keyword signatures and escaped literal semantics.

Added awaited visual pipeline executor; advanced saved suites remain savable with explicit failure on unsupported external export. Fixed debug final-step/Stop/error status and load-handler ordering. Real Robot dry-run and fixture argument execution pass.

Zero/negative/fraction policy validation, exact pixel alpha checks, unique live runner IDs, bounded page loads, local Monaco assets, disabled runtime modes and unique DOM routing reviewed; final 26 tests pass.

capability_limits: Infrastructure Docker/Kubernetes/network backends are unavailable in this build. They return explicit ERROR; no scanner success is fabricated.
OSV package lookups require exact resolved versions. Semver ranges produce incomplete-coverage ERROR; lockfile resolution remains future work.
Jest/JUnit/NUnit browser execution requires a real backend. Unsupported framework modes fail visibly; Custom is an explicit browser assertion-script mode.
JavaScript timeout cancellation is cooperative via AbortSignal; synchronous loops cannot be preempted on the UI thread.
Pytest package loading may need network/package availability on first use. Missing packages are a visible failure.
Advanced visual assertions require the LVX visual executor. External Robot exports contain explicit Fail rows rather than silently omitting advanced steps.
